title: Measure Theory in Convergence Spaces Part I: Sion-Carathéodory Extension in Net Convergence Groups
summary: We establish a Carathéodory-type extension theorem for premeasures with values in general separated abelian net convergence groups. Starting from hereditary exhaustivity on the source ring and intrinsic conditions for combining null errors, we construct a countably additive extension on a regulated Boolean sigma-algebra, with full upper and lower regularity in the original convergence. Completeness is required only on the limit-stable hull of the source range.
